claim: A manner PP with comparative as or like as head is “discussed in more detail in Ch. 13, §§5–6”.
evidence_summary: The Ch. 13 contents (p. 1097) list “5.5 As”, “5.6 Like” and “6 Scalar set comparison”. Manner as is treated on p. 1149 (“Here the as phrase functions as manner element in the matrix”), and manner like on pp. 1155–1156 (“(b) Manner complement”; “Likeness of manner”). §6, on plain, comparative and superlative grade, has nothing on manner as or like.
finding: §6 is wrong. The intended reference is probably §§5.5–5.6, but that’s the reader’s inference. The authors’ erratum for p. 733, which corrects Ch. 15, §§10–11 to §§2.10–2.11, is the same kind of slip.
inference: Does §6 of Ch. 13 discuss manner as and like?

evidence.passage: §2.1, p. 671. “discussed in more detail in Ch. 13, §§5–6”.
evidence.establishes: The material is in §§5.5–5.6. §6 is scalar set comparison.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
